card.name: Pipe separators in trial registry fields
card.fires_on: The vertical bar or space that closes a field value in ClinicalTrials.gov-style records, such as after a start date, design item or official title. It fires just before the next field label or free-text section begins.

modes.label: After date or design value
modes.description: The separator right after a start date, completion date or study design entry, before the next field label.

modes.label: After title or outcome text
modes.description: The separator or space after an official title or a safety-issue bracket, before the description or next bullet.
